$schema_note: Phase 0 Unit 0.2 Step 1.5 deliverable. ElevenLabs v3 adapter for cadence-spec.md. Consumed by scripts/generate-tts-eval.ts (Step 2 engine matrix). ElevenLabs v3 does NOT accept long-form natural-language cadence-spec; this adapter encodes the spec as voice_settings numeric values + sparse inline bracket-tag annotations + a Voice Design prompt for minting a new voice. NEVER concatenate cadence-spec prose into the text payload — the model will read it aloud.
model_mode_note: v3 surfaces three generation modes ('Creative' / 'Natural' / 'Robust') via the playground; the API request uses model_id='eleven_v3' for all three. 'Natural' is the right balance for Sterling-CODED: 'Creative' over-expresses (Floor — sounds like a performer), 'Robust' under-expresses (Floor — sounds robotic). When the API exposes an explicit mode parameter, set to 'Natural'.

_rationale.stability: 0.70 sits above the 0.50 default to suppress F0 wandering (cadence-spec §3.1 calls for narrow ±15 Hz spread on declaratives) but stays below 0.85 so the §3.5 parenthetical-tangent waver still lands. Going to 0.90+ flattens the read into audiobook narration (Floor-band failure).
_rationale.similarity_boost: 0.75 default for Path A (preset Voice Library voice — we want the voice to BE itself, not be steered far). For Path B (Briggsy clone), bump to 0.85 to lean harder into his timbre.
_rationale.style: 0.15 low to suppress engine-default expressive swelling (cadence-spec §3.6 'compressed dynamic range'). Not 0 because the §3.5 exhale + §3.4 downspeak punchline need SOME style budget to land. If Step 2 outputs sound flat / lifeless, bump to 0.25.
_rationale.use_speaker_boost: true (default) — clarity boost helps the §3.3 General American articulation hold up against background that the trailer scene will add later.
_rationale.speed: 0.95 = 5% slower than conversational baseline per cadence-spec §3.2 ('phoneme durations approximately 5-10% longer'). 0.92 if Step 2 outputs feel rushed; 0.97 if too slow.

path_A_voice_library_filter._purpose: Search criteria for selecting the Path A preset voice from the ElevenLabs Voice Library (the generic catalog with commercial rights baked into the Creator plan). Apply these filters in the ElevenLabs UI; document the chosen voice_id in account-readiness.md before Step 2 generates.
path_A_voice_library_filter.warburton_avoidance_note: Step 0.5 cold-reader signal flagged the Gemini Charon read as Patrick-Warburton-adjacent. Path A voice should avoid overshooting into a SECOND recognizable commercial voice — prefer slightly less archetype-distinctive Voice Library options. If shortlist is between two voices, pick the LESS commercially recognizable one.

path_B_voice_clone._purpose: Briggsy's own voice cloned via ElevenLabs Instant Voice Cloning (Creator-tier feature). Path B only proceeds if Briggsy explicitly opts in — see preflight/account-readiness.md retention-policy verification before sample submission.
path_B_voice_clone.method: Instant Voice Cloning (NOT Professional Voice Cloning — IVC needs only 10s sample, PVC needs 30+ minutes recording session)

recording_conditions.mic: cardioid (dynamic OK; condenser preferred if available)
recording_conditions.environment: closet or fabric-draped corner — kill room reflections (no bathroom, no kitchen, no parking garage)
recording_conditions.neutral_text_prompt: Use a 15-second neutral-text read (any deadpan declarative content — NOT acting, NOT performance). Trim post-recording to cleanest 10s. Sample text MUST NOT include any Phase 1+ trailer narration — keep the clone sample independent of the trailer script.

consent_and_retention.retention_window: Indefinite under ElevenLabs Creator plan default terms — ownership of source audio does NOT auto-grant deletable-on-demand retention.
consent_and_retention.pre_submission_check: Verify deletion-on-request procedure works AND that ElevenLabs honors deletion as an API contract (test with throwaway clone first). Record findings in account-readiness.md.
consent_and_retention.post_phase_0_cleanup: If Path B is NOT selected as winning path, delete the Briggsy voice clone within 7 days of Phase 0 exit. Verify deletion. Record in post-eval-cleanup.md.

voice_settings_override._rationale: Path B benefits from a higher similarity_boost than Path A — we WANT the clone to sound like Briggsy, not a generic baritone.

voice_design_prompt: A mid-baritone American male voice in his late thirties to mid-forties, speaking with the dry confidence of a senior intelligence briefer who has explained the same procedures dozens of times. Mean fundamental frequency around 110 to 120 hertz with very little variation. General American accent, rhotic — pronounce R sounds at word endings. Avoid British, Mid-Atlantic, or Transatlantic shading. Articulation is conversational and clear, never theatrical or stage-trained. Pace is slightly slower than conversational baseline; the speaker never rushes a joke. Inflection stays predominantly flat on declarative sentences. Compressed dynamic range — small amplitude excursions, no swelling, no swallowed phrases. Tonal register cluster: deadpan briefing voice, sardonic detective, film noir narrator, world-weary spy. NOT: audiobook narrator, documentary voiceover, podcast intro, AI assistant, energetic salesperson.
voice_design_prompt_anti_pattern_note: The Voice Design prompt is sent to ElevenLabs ONCE during voice minting — it instructs the model on what kind of voice to GENERATE, not how to PERFORM each line. It MUST NOT contain the trailer script content, line directions, or any text intended to be read aloud — those go in the text payload, scoped by bracket tags only.

bracket_tags_per_paragraph._purpose: Inline annotations in the text payload at the position where the tag's effect should apply. Tags are sparse — overuse degrades the read into mechanical performance. Default to NO tag if the voice_settings alone produce the right shape.
bracket_tags_per_paragraph._anti_pattern: NEVER insert free-prose direction into the text payload (e.g. 'read this in a deadpan voice') — ElevenLabs v3 reads everything that is not a recognized bracket tag aloud verbatim. The VOICE_DIRECTION guard in generate-tts-eval.ts asserts the text payload contains only the script + recognized bracket tags.

deadpan-exposition.notes: voice_settings already biased toward deadpan; one leading tag reinforces the intent. The '— fine, me —' parenthetical should ride the voice_settings stability+style alone; add `[sarcastic]` only if Step 2 round 1 shows the tangent failing to land.

inline_tags.rationale: cadence-spec §3.5 exhausted-exhale signature on the line that pivots from credentials-flex into 'tell anyone' threat
the ellipsis already cues the deadpan-flat delivery the spec calls for in §3.5 mannerisms; [sarcastic] tag reinforces the sardonic-micro-lift on terminal syllables per §3.4

scream.notes: Sterling-LANA four-axis shape (cadence-spec §3.6 — refined 2026-05-18 in Unit 0.6 audition): (1) flat pitch (no F0 falsetto rise), (2) 6-12 dB amplitude jump above conversational baseline, (3) FIRST-vowel drag (stretched EE in V-EE-ra, encoded as repeated E chars), (4) accent anchored on first syllable (first-vowel drag dominates any trailing-vowel drag). ElevenLabs v3 audition outcome: [shouts] tag clears axis 1+2, structural text shape (VEEEEEEEERAAAA — 8 E's + 4 A's) clears axis 3+4. v2 failure mode (trailing-A drag VERAAAAAAAAAAA) triggered R+A blend elongation AND accent shift to second syllable — encoded as the test `eCount > aCount` constraint in sample-script-dash.test.ts. Step 2 acceptance: listen for amplitude jump WITHOUT pitch falsetto + sustained EE WITHOUT accent shift. If [shouts] produces a panicked-pitch-rising scream OR drag lands on the wrong vowel, flag in results.md.

output_format_preference._rationale: mp3 44.1kHz/128kbps matches WebMUSHRA listener-panel standard (Phase 0 Unit 0.2 Step 3 MUSHRA-protocol.md) and minimizes char-budget audit ambiguity. PCM alternates available if Step 6 final-render pipeline needs uncompressed input from this matrix.

char_budget_planning._rationale: Step 2 first matrix run is approximately 2% of monthly char-budget — very comfortable. The 80% halt tripwire would only fire if Step 2 burns 40+ full matrix runs in one month, which would itself signal a deeper problem (e.g. spec needs major revision).

amendments.change: Initial draft. Path A / Path B / Voice Design / bracket-tag mappings derived from cadence-spec.md §3 + ElevenLabs v3 API surface verified via Context7 2026-05-18.
amendments.trigger: Step 1.5 deliverable — all three engines green, Step 2 generation can begin once Briggsy approves Path B opt-in / opt-out.
